svg.title: The olfactory pathway answering 3-octanol and 4-methylcyclohexanol: projection neurons by glomerulus, one fly's Kenyon cells, APL and MBON11
svg.text: The olfactory pathway answering two odors
3-octanol drives many glomeruli and 657 of one fly's 4064 Kenyon cells; 4-methylcyclohexanol, with the receptor input the evidence supports, drives two strongly and 109 Kenyon cells,
50 of them shared. That gap is what keeps rung 9's learning test failing: pairing 4-methylcyclohexanol can barely touch 3-octanol's Kenyon cells.
projection neurons, by glomerulus (40 ms bins)
Kenyon cells (one fly), each spike a tick
